reasons.driver: Fill in the driver and the year the licence was first issued.
reasons.covers: Fill in the required terms of the selected covers.
reasons.questions: Answer the required questions. A knock-out answer does not allow a quote.
reasons.premium: Calculate a current premium for the present details first.
reasons.bind: The quote has not been bound.
reasons.vehicleValue: Enter the vehicle value: Own damage cover is priced on it.

issues.valueForCover: Vehicle value is required for Own damage cover.

policyholder.name: Name
policyholder.startDateHelp: One-year term. A start today takes effect in one hour, because new business cannot start retroactively.

driver.name: Driver
driver.birthDateNote: The driver's date of birth is read from the customer record and is not shown here.
driver.yearFirstLicensed: Year the licence was first issued

covers.valueHelp: Own damage is priced on the value of the vehicle.

questions.knockOutBody: A quote cannot be issued with this answer. Correct the answer if it was entered by mistake.
questions.referralTitle: This answer leads to a referral
questions.referralBody: The quote will be referred to an underwriter before it can be bound.

illustrativeTariff.title: Illustrative tariff
illustrativeTariff.body: Premiums are calculated with illustrative test tables and are not an official rating.

provisionalTax.title: Provisional taxes and levies
provisionalTax.body: The insurance premium tax or levy uses a value that has not been legally verified and may change.

uw.title: Underwriting

decisionBody.ACCEPT: The risk is accepted. The quote can be bound.
decisionBody.REFER: The risk is referred to an underwriter. The quote cannot be bound until it is approved.
decisionBody.DECLINE: The risk is declined. The quote cannot be bound.

uw.noIssues: There are no open underwriting issues.

hire.out_of_scope: Hire or reward carriage of passengers

draft.failed: The draft could not be saved

premium.failed: The premium could not be calculated
premium.staleTitle: The details changed after the calculation
premium.staleBody: The premium shown is no longer valid. Calculate it again before you continue.
premium.emptyBody: The calculation saves the draft, prices the risk and checks underwriting.

submission.failed: The quote could not be started

reasons.alreadyBound: The quote has already been bound.
reasons.stale: The details changed: calculate the premium again.
reasons.declined: Cannot bind: the risk was declined.
reasons.referred: Cannot bind: the quote awaits an underwriter's approval.

bind.boundBody: Term status: {state}. The invoice is issued by Billing.
bind.noQuoteBody: Go back to the «Premium» step and calculate again.
bind.gateFailedBody: Not all conditions for binding are met. The quote is unchanged.
bind.planAnnualHelp: The whole premium in one instalment.

dialog.title: Confirm binding
dialog.confirmRequired: Confirm that you want to proceed.
dialog.body: The quote will be bound for a total of {total} with payment plan {plan}. This creates a policy and charges.

vehicleValue.what: The vehicle value is missing, so {cover} cannot be priced.
vehicleValue.fix: Enter the market value of the vehicle in euro in the field «{label}».

firstRegistrationYear.what: The year of first registration is missing or not valid.
firstRegistrationYear.fix: Enter a year from 1950 to next year in the field «{label}».

engineCapacityCc.what: The engine capacity is missing or not valid.
engineCapacityCc.fix: Enter the engine capacity in cc (1 to 20,000) in the field «{label}».

vehicleDetails.what: The vehicle is missing its year of first registration or its engine capacity.
vehicleDetails.fix: Fill in «{label}» and the engine capacity on the vehicle step.

usage.what: The use of the vehicle is not valid.

dateOfBirth.what: The driver has no date of birth on the customer record, and the premium depends on the driver's age.
dateOfBirth.fix: Open the driver's customer record and add the date of birth, or choose another driver, then calculate again.

licenceDate.what: The date the licence was first issued is missing or not valid.
licenceDate.fix: Enter the year in the field «{label}».

claims.what: The number of claims is not valid.
claims.fix: Enter a whole number from 0 to 50 for «{label}», or leave it empty for none.

driver.what: The main driver of the vehicle is missing.
driver.fix: Choose the policyholder or another customer as the driver.

coverages.what: No cover is selected, or a cover is selected twice.

effectiveDate.what: The start date is not valid for rating.
effectiveDate.fix: Choose a start date from today onwards in the field «{label}».

unknown.what: The premium engine rejected one of the details entered.
unknown.fix: Check the details on each step, correct anything that looks wrong and calculate again. Give support the technical details below if it keeps happening.
